title: Type B+NYC unit storage facilities.
officialText:
Where storage facilities are provided within the Type B+NYC dwelling unit or
sleeping unit, they shall comply with Section 905 (Storage Facilities) of ICC A117.1.
Exceptions:
1. A turning space shall not be required in storage facilities.
2. Where accessible storage elements are not in compliance with Section 905.3 of ICC A117.1, the owner shall relocate
such elements to be in compliance with the section at the time a person with physical disabilities takes occupancy of
the unit, or within 10 days of the date the request is made by a person with physical disabilities, whichever is later, at
the owner’s expense.
